sections.executive_summary: Saudi air defenses intercepted six Houthi ballistic missiles targeting Mecca, Taif, and Yanbu, while Israeli forces eliminated Hamas's finance chief in Khan Younis after he directed over one billion shekels to the group. Netanyahu declared at the UN that Iran's regime will fall and described striking its nuclear facilities as an easy decision. Iranian President Pezeshkian distanced Tehran from Houthi actions and offered to relinquish 60% enriched uranium under NPT commitments.

points: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian told Fox News that the Houthis are responsible for their own actions and do not receive directives from Tehran, adding that Iran is prepared to give up its 60% enriched uranium stockpile within the framework of international law and the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/394673)
Turkmenistan has closed its airspace to Iranian aircraft, according to an initial report. (Source: @kianmeli1/92446)

Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and IAEA Director General Rafael Grossi discussed ongoing military attacks against Iranian nuclear facilities, alongside Ukrainian strikes on the Zaporizhzhia and Enerhodar nuclear plants, during a meeting in New York. (Source: @SharghDaily/185612)

Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi held bilateral meetings with his Russian, Portuguese, Cypriot, and Ukrainian counterparts on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York. (Source: @presstv/208191, @presstv/208199, @presstv/208204, @mamlekate/104612)
Two ballistic missiles were reportedly launched from the vicinity of Urmia in northwestern Iran, per initial reports. (Source: @kianmeli1/92449)

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu stated at the UN that attacking Iran's nuclear facilities was "one of the easiest decisions" of his premiership, while IDF Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir assessed the Iranian regime as "wounded and battered but has failed to change its intentions." (Source: @mamlekate/104618, @manniefabian/59235)

IDF and Shin Bet conducted a targeted killing in Khan Younis, southern Gaza, eliminating Muhammad Abu Alwan, head of Hamas's finance department, who oversaw the transfer of over 1 billion shekels to fund Hamas military operations throughout the war and recently worked to rebuild the group's capabilities in violation of the ceasefire. (Source: @New_security8200/203918)

IDF engineering and reconnaissance forces demolished the home in Beit Ammarin of the terrorist who killed Yehuda Sherman on March 21, 2026, operating under the Shomron Brigade. (Source: @idf_telegram/25193)

At the commissioning ceremony for the sixth Dolphin-class submarine INS Drakon, Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir declared the navy reaches "new heights" in covert, far-reaching, deep, and lethal capabilities, while emphasizing continuous monitoring of Iran and its proxies. (Source: @manniefabian/59235)

Netanyahu's UN General Assembly address lasted approximately 40 minutes, during which he predicted the Iranian regime's downfall and offered a Starlink device to the Iranian delegation to bypass censorship. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7486, @Faytuks_Network/7484)
An Israeli Air Force Nachshon Shavit SIGINT aircraft (tail 684, hex 738A4B) returned to base after a day-long mission to Berlin, Germany. (Source: @shin_persian/10414)
Netanyahu dismissed international focus on "settler violence," claiming perhaps two victims per year versus thousands of attacks from the other side. (Source: @amitsegal/65176)

Hamas finance chief Muhammad Abu Alwan was killed in an IDF/Shin Bet strike in Khan Younis; he had managed the group's budget for nearly a decade and directed over 1 billion shekels to sustain Hamas governance and military survival during the war. (Source: @New_security8200/203918)

IDF forces demolished the family home of the attacker who murdered Yehuda Sherman in Beit Ammarin village, West Bank, as part of ongoing deterrence operations in Judea and Samaria. (Source: @idf_telegram/25193)

Security forces continue targeting Hamas financial networks, including money changers and facilitators handling hundreds of millions of dollars, to prevent reconstruction of military infrastructure. (Source: @New_security8200/203918)
The IDF maintains deployment in southern Gaza per the ceasefire agreement while acting to remove immediate threats. (Source: @New_security8200/203918)

Daily monitoring recorded 105 alerts across Lebanon, including 64 drone sightings concentrated in Meidoun, Burj al-Barajneh, Jibshit, Beirut, and Jnah; most active districts: Nabatieh (32), Tyre (16), Marjayoun (13). (Source: @redlinkleb/44802)
Seven Israeli airstrikes hit locations including Bint Jbeil (2), Al-Mansouri, Nabatieh al-Fawqa, Kfar Tibnit, Al-Qantara, and Kfar Shouba. (Source: @redlinkleb/44802)

Twenty-four artillery shelling incidents struck Al-Mansouri (4), Zoutar al-Sharqiya (3), Barishit (3), Wadi al-Saluqi (2), Meidoun (2), Deir Kfar Reman (2), Zibqin (2), Beit Yahoun (1), Beit Lif (1), Haddatha (1), Kfar Kila (1), Nabatieh al-Fawqa (1), and Mazraat Buyut al-Siyad (1). (Source: @redlinkleb/44802)
A signal scan alert was issued for the Western Beqaa region at maximum caution level. (Source: @redlinkleb/44815)
Warplanes were tracked heading south on live mapping. (Source: @redlinkleb/44809)
Iraq's Islamic Resistance movement al-Nujaba commemorated the anniversary of Hezbollah leader Hassan Nasrallah's martyrdom. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/394691)

The Damascus government began distributing new Kurdish curricula to students in northeastern Syria, which include maps and depictions of "Greater Kurdistan" incorporating parts of Iraqi territory alongside other countries. (Source: @naya_foriraq/91529)

Saudi civil defense issued and then lifted an emergency warning for Mecca after six Houthi ballistic missiles were intercepted; air defenses also neutralized attempts targeting Taif and Yanbu, with simultaneous alerts for coastal Red Sea cities including Taif, Jeddah, and Tabuk. (Source: @VahidOnline/78509)
Advance alerts were activated in multiple Saudi cities, including Mecca, following a Houthi attack. (Source: @New_security8200/203926)
The Houthis announced missile and drone launches against a "sensitive target" in Riyadh and against Saudi Aramco facilities in Yanbu. (Source: @asafroz/53766)
A Turkish Aksungur ISTAR UCAV was tracked operating near the Turkish-Iranian border region. (Source: @shin_persian/10411)
